summary: Legal document proving property is free from registered financial liabilities, bank mortgages, court attachments, or title claims.

steps.title: Identify property survey/khasra number
steps.description: Locate exact village, sector, survey/plot number, and previous deed registered numbers.

steps.title: Apply on Sub-Registrar online portal
steps.description: Enter search period (e.g. 15 or 30 years), applicant details, and property boundary descriptions.

steps.title: Sub-registrar index verification
steps.description: Department records examiner searches Book 1 registered property deed archives.

steps.title: Download Nil Encumbrance Certificate (Form 15/16)
steps.description: Receive digitally signed EC certifying clean title or listing registered mortgages/encumbrances.
